name: NeoSky — API on RapidAPI
description:
NASA space data in ready-to-render responses: NeoSky serves the Astronomy Picture of the Day and near-Earth object data — browsable lists and date-range feeds — for science apps, widgets and content products.

What you get:
- The Astronomy Picture of the Day with its title, explanation and media URLs, formatted for direct display
- Near-Earth object browsing: paged lists of asteroids tracked by NASA, with size, velocity and approach data
- A date-range NEO feed for building calendars, alerts and "what is passing Earth this week" features
- Honest error behaviour: if NASA's upstream feed has no valid entry for a date, the API returns a clear error instead of placeholder content

Key endpoints:
- GET /apod — Astronomy Picture of the Day (today or a specific date)
- GET /neo/browse — browse near-Earth objects as a paged list
- GET /neo/feed — near-Earth objects approaching within a date range

Batch / built for workflows:
The NEO endpoints are list-shaped by design: /neo/browse pages through the full catalogue and /neo/feed returns a whole date window in one call, so scheduled content jobs, daily widgets and alert pipelines can pull a complete set per run. Please note that APOD availability depends on NASA's upstream service; when that feed is unavailable, /apod responds with an explicit error rather than substitute data.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
